response.original_title: 舞踏歌劇 怒羅吸裸〜The Live Black Mass B.D.4〜Dracula: A Kabuki Rock Opera
response.overview: Created and performed by legendary Japanese heavy metal band Seikima-II, renowned for their demonic personas and grandiose stage spectacles, this theatrical production reimagines Bram Stoker's classic vampire tale as a full-scale Kabuki rock opera. Starring vocalist His Excellency Demon Kakka as Count Dracula alongside the band's musicians in dramatic roles, the play weaves original heavy metal compositions, classical Japanese dance, elaborate period costumes, and gothic horror storytelling into a tragic saga of immortality, love, and eternal darkness.
response.title: Seikima-II: Dracula - A Kabuki Rock Opera (The Live Black Mass B.D.4)
